audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits WR 49.28 over 349 games: Brand out-pokes levels 1-2, Taliyah takes over from 3 with W-E against an immobile target.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart is a blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows while packet levelChart and content win[] agree: Brand rows 0-1, Taliyah rows 2-6.
audit.why: Brand Q 1050 range + W 900 out-range level-1 Taliyah Q; from 3, Taliyah's W-E stun combo punishes Brand's zero mobility. Both other layers already carry this.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to packet/content with whys rewritten per row.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text calls Pillar of Flame 'his only hard CC' — Pillar has no CC; Brand's hard CC is Sear's stun, which only triggers on an ablaze target. breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers.
audit.why: Kit: Sear 8s CD rank 1, stuns only if target is ablaze (hit by W/E first); Pillar of Flame is delayed AoE damage (+25% on ablaze), no CC; E 13s; R 100s. Taliyah W-through-E detonates the stun on the dash-less Brand.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] reworded; cooldowns field now carries 8s Sear / 14s W numbers and sequencing.

audit.why: Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s is the gate; after he burns it he cannot stun for 6-8s.

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Brand wins level 1 — Pillar of Flame's 900 range and Sear's 1050 out-reach your single Q, so last-hit at max range and dodge the delay circle.

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: Still his: two Blaze stacks plus Sear is a stun-chunk your two spells cannot answer yet — respect until 3.

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit flips it: W-shove him through E mines for the stun — Brand has no dash, no shield, and no way out of the combo.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke each wave contact; once he burns Sear on a minion he has no stun for 6-8s and you commit.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Weaver's Wall online — you out-roam the immobile Brand completely, and your W-E all-in still beats his stationary combo.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes him before Blaze stacks — force river fights your stones pre-seeded.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late you pick him first: W-E-R before he stacks Pyroclasm and he cannot reposition — never group and eat the full bounce.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It governs your forward steps. - W Seismic Shove spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — 8s at rank 1, and it only stuns while you are ablaze; after eating W or E, that line is the dodge that matters. Once it whiffs, you own 6-8 seconds. - Your W is 14s early: spent on poke it is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Seed E between you before trading — Brand has no dash, so when he walks up to stack Blaze the W-shove through the mines is always loaded and he knows it.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: His Pillar of Flame and Sear both travel — a stationary cast is the frame every Brand combo starts on, so keep moving through your own volley.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan across resets; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
